title: Qualification version changes invalidate every dependent capability
blocker: The repository has deterministic capability hashes and a component snapshot authority, but no production qualification signer, trust-root rotation/revocation workflow, compatibility catalog, or product consumer that invalidates cached decisions across all entry points.
assertions: a capability records the exact publisher snapshot, qualification profile, policy version and verifier identity it consumed
changing any referenced qualification content or signer version invalidates the old capability before scheduling or attach
an unrelated profile change does not invalidate capabilities whose dependency set is disjoint
revoked, unknown or stale signer identities fail closed without a runtime override
